name: Pi presence
author: loncelll
description: One pi icon for every Pi coding-agent session; it opens a popup of live sessions, their status bubbles, and a button that jumps to the session's terminal.

barWidget.description: pi icon in the tray drawer; click for every running Pi session, what each is doing, and a jump to its terminal.

service.description: Drives general:border_size and general:col.active_border through hyprctl eval: an accent gradient while a Pi works, solid urgent when one waits for you, the theme baseline restored when all are idle.
